beats.say: Julia Stiles personally asked Michelle Williams for permission before honouring Heath Ledger.
Variety says Stiles sought her full blessing for a Dancing With the Stars routine.
The special dance paid tribute to her former 10 Things I Hate About You co-star.
Michelle Williams and Heath Ledger dated from 2004 to 2007 and share a daughter named Matilda.
Ledger tragically died in January 2008 at the age of 28 from an accidental drug overdose.
Which Heath Ledger film performance will always be your favourite?
